description: Retrieve the latest block number for Ethereum or Base using a single eth_blockNumber JSON-RPC call; live chain state may change between calls. USE WHEN: an agent needs the current chain height for Ethereum or Base as a synchronization, sequencing, or transaction-context reference. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs block contents, transactions, wallet balances, gas prices, historical blocks, confirmations, or finality. Parameter semantics: chain accepts exactly ethereum or base and is case-sensitive. Returns chain, block_number as a decimal integer, and observed_at as a UTC timestamp.

chain.description: EVM network to query for the latest block number.
